title: [CQ-C07a] Daemon-owned plan reuse state
description:
Split from CQ-C07 (task-93dee42f71db4a6a8e47a8de052ad411) on 2026-10-27 by architect-2c9d5121, under the governor's plan-don't-park directive ("If a prerequisite's contract must be designed first, split it out (SPIDR, as with R10a)"). C07's reuse decision needs state that does not exist yet: the commit an approved plan was submitted against, and how the task last entered PLANNING. This row lands that state contract and nothing else. CQ-C07b (assessment library) and CQ-C07 (claim/context integration) consume it.

Objective: give the daemon durable, daemon-owned facts that an approved-plan reuse decision can be computed from. No decision logic.

Deliverable (the contract C07b and C07 build against; implement it exactly):
1. packages/moe-daemon/src/types/schema.ts
   - PlanSourceBasis { version: 1; commit: string; planRevision: number }. commit is the full 40- or 64-hex id that `HEAD^{commit}` resolved to when submit_plan ran. planRevision is the revision that PLAN_SUBMITTED write committed.
   - PlanningEntry { from: TaskStatus; at: string; seq: number }. from is the status the task left when it last entered PLANNING, at is that write's ISO time, and seq is a per-task counter starting at 1.
   - PlanReuseDecision = 'reuse' | 'refresh' | 'reassess' | 'replan'.
   - PlanReuseRecord { version: 1; decision: PlanReuseDecision; planRevision: number; entrySeq: number; reasons: string[]; assessedAt: string; basisCommit?: string; headCommit?: string; changedPaths?: string[]; candidate?: 'current' | 'revalidate' }. Limits:
     - reasons: 0-32 items of 1-300 chars, no control characters;
     - changedPaths: at most 64 normalized repo-relative paths;
     - commits: 40 or 64 lowercase hex;
     - planRevision and entrySeq: non-negative safe integers;
     - assessedAt: an ISO string.
   - Task gains optional planSourceBasis, planningEntry and planReuse. Their JSDoc says: daemon-owned, never approval, readiness or evidence.
2. New packages/moe-daemon/src/context/planReuseState.ts
   - readPlanSourceBasis(task), readPlanningEntry(task) and readPlanReuseRecord(task) check the exact enumerable key set (mem gotcha-strict-decoder-key-set), return detached copies, return null for anything malformed, and never throw.
   - validatePlanReuseRecord(value) applies the same rules and throws INVALID_INPUT.
   - capturePlanSourceBasis(projectRoot): Promise<{ commit: string } | null> runs openProjectGit (util/cachedPlanPaths.ts) with a 2000 ms budget, then `rev-parse --verify --end-of-options HEAD^{commit}`. It returns null on any failure (non-Git root, foreign toplevel, unborn HEAD, timeout) and never throws.
   - Export the seam `planSourceGit = { run: runGit }`, mirroring requiredCheckGit in delivery/requiredChecks.ts.
3. state/taskStore.ts updateTask
   - Strip planSourceBasis, planningEntry and planReuse from every caller update, beside the existing executionPolicySnapshot strip.
   - The private daemonOwned argument gains planSourceBasis?: { commit } and planReuse?: PlanReuseRecord.
   - A PLAN_SUBMITTED write that passes daemonOwned writes planSourceBasis { version: 1, commit, planRevision: <this write's derived revision> } when supplied, and deletes it otherwise. This is the requiredCheckSnapshot pattern.
   - daemonOwned.planReuse is validated and written on any event. Absent, the field is left untouched.
   - A status change INTO PLANNING stamps planningEntry { from: previous status, at: this write's updatedAt, seq: previous valid seq + 1 } in the same write. The one exception: a return from BLOCKED whose blockedFromStatus is PLANNING keeps the earlier entry. createTask never stamps it.
4. server/WebSocketServer.ts: UPDATE_TASK_DENYLIST lists the three keys (mem convention-daemon-owned-task-field-ws-denylist).
5. tools/submitPlan.ts captures the basis once per call, OUTSIDE the state mutex, next to measureRequiredCheckSnapshot; the cached-path retry reuses it. It passes the basis in the PLAN_SUBMITTED daemonOwned argument. A capture failure never refuses the submission and adds no warnings.

NOT in scope:
- any reuse decision or Git comparison (CQ-C07b);
- claim, wait and get_context changes, and task resumption (CQ-C07);
- new activity event types;
- JetBrains or VS Code parity;
- docs/SCHEMA.md (the CQ-C11 docs sweep);
- dirty-byte provenance.

Verification command: cd packages/moe-daemon && npm test. Run it fresh; it must exit 0. The full daemon suite is required because the Task schema is shared.
definitionOfDone: submit_plan stores planSourceBasis {version 1, commit equal to `git rev-parse HEAD`, planRevision equal to the committed revision} in its PLAN_SUBMITTED write, and every resubmission refreshes it. A non-Git project root, or a Git failure injected through planSourceGit.run, still submits successfully, with no basis and any older basis removed. Proven by vitest cases in context/planReuseState.test.ts against a real temporary Git repo.

Entering PLANNING stamps planningEntry, each case a named vitest case:
- BACKLOG->PLANNING gives {from BACKLOG, seq 1}.
- A later WORKING->PLANNING gives seq 2, from WORKING.
- qa_reject escalation gives from REVIEW.
- BLOCKED (blockedFromStatus PLANNING)->PLANNING keeps the earlier entry.
- BLOCKED (blockedFromStatus WORKING)->PLANNING gives from BLOCKED.
- createTask never stamps.

planSourceBasis, planningEntry and planReuse are daemon-owned:
- A caller's updateTask value (including null) is stripped, leaving the stored value unchanged.
- The /ws UPDATE_TASK path drops forged values: a WebSocketServer.test.ts case, pinned with vi.spyOn(state, 'updateTask').
- Only taskStore.updateTask's daemonOwned argument writes planReuse. A malformed record throws INVALID_INPUT and writes nothing.
Fresh `cd packages/moe-daemon && npm test` exits 0, and its output is supplied to complete_task.
taskRails: No direct .moe edits; no Git-write commands by agents; wrappers own landing.
Do not enable verified-local or claim isolation until all requisite implementation and certification gates pass.
